name: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund
oneLiner: ACRED is a tokenized, NAV-accreting feeder share into Apollo's diversified private credit fund, administered by Securitize for qualified purchasers.
collateral: Feeder share into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, a multi-strategy private credit portfolio including direct lending, structured credit, performing credit, and dislocated credit; administered by Securitize
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting ERC-4626 fund share token; subscription and redemption are institutional-only at fund NAV through Securitize Markets, with quarterly repurchase offers of at least 5% of shares plus on-demand liquidity-pool or secondary-market sales for intra-quarter exits; RedStone publishes the NAV oracle used by integrations

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Securitize operates ACRED with permissioned token transfers restricted to KYC-onboarded qualified purchasers and retains transfer-agent freeze and burn authority on behalf of Apollo.

mintAuthority.summary: ACRED EVM lanes (ETH, Avax, Polygon, Ink) all confirmed: owner() returns the same EOA 0x59c1eAcEc... on all four chains. Aptos owner-chain resolves to an EOA account (0xc35dd22...). Solana mintAuthority is a PDA of an unaudited custom BPFLoader program — cannot confirm from chain state.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ACRED is distributed across Aptos, Avalanche, Ethereum, Ink, Polygon, and Solana through Securitize, with Wormhole identified by Securitize/Wormhole as the interoperability provider for tokenized fund transfers. The route is therefore treated as an external validated-network dependency rather than an issuer-native burn/mint rail.

notices.title: Private credit, not Treasuries
notices.message: ACRED is a feeder into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, which holds direct lending and structured credit positions. Risk profile is medium-to-high and closer to syrupUSDC than to BUIDL or BENJI. Token transfers are permissioned; fund exits are anchored by quarterly repurchase offers of at least 5% of shares, with an on-demand pool or secondary-market sales for intra-quarter liquidity. Pharos tracks the Ethereum, Aptos, Avalanche, Ink, Polygon, and Solana deployments; the Sei issuance via Wormhole is not yet integrated.
